transcript.text: Here's what I learned from plant engineering this morning. Engineering confirmed that the facility can continue to operate lawfully while corrective controls are installed only if the renewal filing limits solvent throughput to exactly 18,000 gallons per month. The problem is that our current operating plan assumes 25,000 gallons per month, and that plan has not been updated — engineering's feasibility confirmation only arrived this morning. So if we submit the operating limits section reflecting our current 25,000-gallon-per-month assumption, we would not be able to lawfully continue operating while the corrective controls are being installed. We need to revise the operating limits in the renewal filing to cap solvent throughput at 18,000 gallons per month, and we need to update the operating plan accordingly. This directly affects what we can certify to in the compliance certification and what numbers go into the operating limits section.
